summary: Tuff is a Hearthian miner who works at the bottom of the mine shaft adjacent to the Zero-G Cave. Tuff has a violent fear of space and floating, to the point of nausea — a great inconvenience given they work next to where astronauts train in zero gravity.

behavior: Tuff has a violent fear of space and anything related to floating.
Tuff gets physically sick just thinking about zero-g.
Tuff dislikes the weird cave they work next to and avoids thinking about it.
Tuff cracks dark jokes about the protagonist's space ambitions but insists they are 'fine.'
Tuff calms themselves by thinking about flat, motionless rocks.
location: Tuff mines ore at the bottom of the mine shaft on Timber Hearth.
Tuff's workplace is next to the Zero-G Cave at the center of Timber Hearth.
lore: Tuff recounts that Tektite saw something crash outside the Village crater and went to check it out.
Tuff knew Tektite checked the Youngbark crash site with the old firewatch scout launcher and saw smoke.
Tuff once said 'safety first' to Tektite, and felt insulted by how long Tektite laughed at it.
Tektite plans to ask Tuff to help haul the old scout launcher out to Youngbark Crater.
